resolutions.answer: Total units = 50. Sum over all six data rows of the units column of package/artifacts/stock.csv (19 + 9 + 9 + 5 + 6 + 2 = 50), header row excluded.

Top sku by units = p1. Maximum of the units column is 19, attained only by sku p1; no tie exists, so the tie-break (smallest sku by ascending lexicographic sku ordering) is not invoked. Price played no role in the selection.
